description.value: Miso Taco is a Mexican-Japanese fusion restaurant on Vancouver's Cambie Street, serving street-food-inspired dishes like teriyaki chicken tacos and pork chashu fillings that blend both culinary traditions. The restaurant is fully licensed, offers online ordering and takeout, and is part of a small growing chain with a second location on West Pender and a North Vancouver outpost announced. Cyclists on the Cambie corridor will find it a distinctive and filling stop with a varied menu including plant-based options.

Takeout is confirmed by a dedicated /take-out subpage and prominent 'ORDER ONLINE' CTA. Vegetarian options are evidenced by explicit menu add-ons listing mushrooms, fried tofu, and fried egg. No evidence exists for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or most other cycle-amenity fields.
